fancy-text-generator.workedExample:
Input: "Hi"
Bold: 𝐇𝐢 (H -> U+1D407, i -> U+1D422)
Italic: 𝐻𝑖 (H -> U+1D43B, i -> U+1D456)
Script: ℋ𝒾 (H -> U+210B, i -> U+1D4F2)
Characters like "!" pass through unchanged: "Hi!" -> bold "𝐇𝐢!"
mistakes: Using it for a resume or job application — applicant tracking systems cannot parse Unicode styling, and your name may vanish.
Assuming screen readers announce it properly — they often spell out each styled letter or skip it, so it harms accessibility.
Putting it in a password or username — many systems reject non-ASCII characters, locking you out of your own account.
Thinking it is a font you installed — it is Unicode characters, so it looks different (or breaks) on older devices.
Mixing five styles in one bio — it looks messy and unprofessional; pick one style and stick with it.
